en: Welcome to the Mt. Chimney Cable Car! Shall I send you up to the summit?
Lovely! Step this way, please, and mind the gap.
The car sways gently on its wire as it climbs above the ash...
Whenever you're ready. The view from the top is worth the trip!
Welcome to the Mt. Chimney Cable Car. Some rough-looking people have been hanging about outside, haven't they?
I'm afraid I can't send anyone up while they're there. Please come back later!
